title: 天文高解析光譜儀~High-resolution astronomical spectrographs
focus: 階梯光柵色散、光纖擾頻、真空溫控、波長校正與公分每秒級徑向速度誤差預算~Echelle dispersion, fibre scrambling, vacuum thermal control, wavelength calibration and cm/s radial-velocity error budgets
summary: 以 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 這類光纖饋入、真空溫控的階梯光柵光譜儀為對象，說明為何 1 m/s 的恆星速度只相當於偵測器上 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，再把階梯光柵與交叉色散、光展量與擾頻、環境穩定、ThAr／標準具／頻率梳校正、CCD 系統誤差與重心修正整合成可驗收的徑向速度量測鏈。~Using fibre-fed, vacuum-stabilised echelle spectrographs such as HARPS and ESPRESSO, show why a 1 m/s stellar velocity is only an 18.7 nm line shift on the detector, then integrate echelle and cross-dispersion, étendue and scrambling, environmental stability, ThAr, etalon and comb calibration, CCD systematics and barycentric correction into an acceptable radial-velocity measurement chain.

units.anchor: 恆星譜線的都卜勒位移~Doppler shift of stellar lines
units.title: 徑向速度量測需求與解析力~Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power
units.mechanism: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。地球質量行星繞類太陽恆星一年軌道只造成約 9 cm/s 的速度半振幅，木星約 12.5 m/s，因此光譜儀必須在數千條譜線上量出遠小於一個像素的位移。解析力 R = λ/Δλ 決定譜線被分開與取樣的程度：R 越高譜線側翼越陡、每條線攜帶的速度資訊越多，但每個解析元素分到的光子越少，所以 R 的選擇是解析度、通量與儀器尺寸之間的取捨。~When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. An Earth-mass planet in a one-year orbit around a Sun-like star produces a velocity semi-amplitude of only about 9 cm/s and Jupiter about 12.5 m/s, so the spectrograph must measure shifts far smaller than a pixel across thousands of lines. Resolving power R = λ/Δλ sets how well lines are separated and sampled: higher R steepens line flanks and gives each line more velocity information, but spreads photons over more resolution elements, so choosing R trades resolution, throughput and instrument size.
units.model: 1 m/s 對應 δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹，在 λ = 550 nm 為 1.83 fm。R = 140 000 時解析元素 Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm，相當於 c/R = 2141 m/s；若每個解析元素取樣 4 個 10 µm 像素，每像素 535 m/s，1 m/s 等於偵測器上 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，約為像素的 1/535。~1 m/s corresponds to δλ/λ = 1/c = 3.34×10⁻⁹, or 1.83 fm at λ = 550 nm. At R = 140 000 the resolution element is Δλ = 550/140 000 = 3.93 pm, equivalent to c/R = 2141 m/s; sampled by four 10 µm pixels each pixel spans 535 m/s, so 1 m/s is a line shift of 10 µm/535 = 18.7 nm on the detector, about 1/535 of a pixel.
units.verify: 觀測長期 RV 散佈小於 1 m/s 的 G、K 矮星與經月球或太陽望遠鏡導入的太陽光，量測譜線半高寬並換算實際交付的 R，與設計值比較；再用校正燈譜線的寬度與其佔用的像素數確認每像素的速度標度，寫入儀器設定檔供管線使用。~Observe G and K dwarfs whose long-term RV scatter is below 1 m/s and sunlight fed through the Moon or a solar telescope, measure line FWHM and convert to the delivered R for comparison with the design; then use calibration-line widths and the number of pixels they cover to confirm the velocity scale per pixel and store it in the instrument configuration used by the pipeline.
units.failure: 只看解析力規格而忽略取樣，每個解析元素少於 2 個像素時譜線欠取樣，像素內響應差異會轉成隨地球公轉速度改變的假訊號；反之若在口徑不足的望遠鏡上把 R 推得過高，每個解析元素的光子不足，RV 精度反而變差。~Quoting resolving power while ignoring sampling leaves lines undersampled below 2 pixels per resolution element, so intrapixel response differences become spurious signals that vary with Earth's orbital velocity; conversely, pushing R too high on a small aperture starves each element of photons and degrades RV precision.
units.misconception: 解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。~Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.

units.anchor: R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器~R4 echelle and cross-disperser
units.title: 階梯光柵方程式、繞射級與交叉色散~Echelle grating equation, orders and cross-dispersion
units.mechanism: 階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。在 Littrow 配置 α ≈ β ≈ θ_B，角色散 dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ 只取決於閃耀角，因此 R4（tanθ_B = 4）光柵的角色散比一般一級光柵高一個數量級。代價是相鄰繞射級重疊，每一級只有很窄的自由光譜範圍 FSR = λ/m，所以要用稜鏡或低刻線密度光柵在垂直方向做交叉色散，把數十個繞射級排成二維梯狀影像鋪滿大面積 CCD。~An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ). In Littrow, α ≈ β ≈ θ_B, the angular dispersion dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ depends only on the blaze angle, so an R4 grating with tanθ_B = 4 disperses an order of magnitude more than a first-order grating. The price is overlapping orders, each with a narrow free spectral range FSR = λ/m, so a prism or low-groove-density grating cross-disperses perpendicular to the echelle and stacks dozens of orders into a two-dimensional ladder that tiles a large CCD.
units.model: 31.6 gr/mm 的 R4 光柵 d = 31.65 µm、θ_B = 75.96°。Littrow 下 m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6，取 m = 112，閃耀波長 548.2 nm，FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm。角色散 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm；相機焦距 0.70 m 時線色散 10.2 µm/pm，3.93 pm 的解析元素佔 40 µm，即 4 個 10 µm 像素。~An R4 grating with 31.6 gr/mm has d = 31.65 µm and θ_B = 75.96°. In Littrow, m = 2d·sinθ_B/λ = 2×31.65×0.970/0.550 ≈ 111.6, so order 112 blazes at 548.2 nm with FSR = 548.2/112 ≈ 4.89 nm. Angular dispersion is 2×4/550 nm = 14.5 mrad/nm; a 0.70 m camera gives 10.2 µm/pm, so a 3.93 pm resolution element covers 40 µm, four 10 µm pixels.
units.verify: 以 ThAr 燈與平場光照亮全部繞射級，追蹤每一級在偵測器上的軌跡，確認相鄰級間距大於光纖像在交叉色散方向的寬度再加背景餘量；以已知波長譜線核對各級的 m 值與色散解，並檢查閃耀函數峰值落在各級中央，自由光譜範圍邊緣的效率約降到峰值的 40%。~Illuminate all orders with a ThAr lamp and a flat field, trace each order across the detector and confirm that inter-order spacing exceeds the fibre-image width in the cross-dispersion direction plus a background margin; check each order's m and dispersion solution against known lines and verify that the blaze peak sits at order centre with efficiency near 40% of peak at the free-spectral-range edges.
units.failure: 以稜鏡做交叉色散時紅端繞射級彼此靠近，光纖像翼部與散射光互相污染，背景扣除錯誤會讓深吸收線變淺並系統性移動譜線重心；光柵刻線的週期性誤差則產生 Rowland 鬼線，可能被誤認為恆星譜線而進入交叉相關遮罩。~With prism cross-dispersion the red orders crowd together, fibre-image wings and scattered light contaminate neighbours, and wrong background subtraction makes deep lines shallower and systematically moves their centroids; periodic ruling errors create Rowland ghosts that can be mistaken for stellar lines and enter the cross-correlation mask.
units.misconception: 階梯光柵刻線越密，角色散就越大。~A more finely ruled echelle always gives larger angular dispersion.

units.anchor: 光纖饋入與擾頻器~Fibre feed and scrambler
units.title: 光展量、光纖擾頻與瞳切割~Étendue, fibre scrambling and pupil slicing
units.mechanism: 對狹縫限制的光譜儀，R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B：望遠鏡口徑 D_T 越大、天空孔徑 φ 越大，要維持同樣的 R 就需要越大的準直光束與光柵，這是 8 m 級望遠鏡高解析光譜儀體積龐大的根源。光纖把望遠鏡焦面與溫控光譜儀分開，並以擾頻讓輸出的近場與遠場不再跟隨輸入光點位置；八角形或方形芯光纖改善近場擾頻，雙擾頻器以透鏡交換近場與遠場。瞳切割與變形光學把光束切半或壓縮單一方向，等效縮小所需的光柵尺寸。~For a slit-limited spectrograph R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B: a larger telescope aperture D_T or sky aperture φ demands a larger collimated beam and grating for the same R, which is why high-resolution spectrographs on 8 m telescopes are so large. Fibres separate the telescope focus from the thermally controlled spectrograph and scramble the light so the output near and far fields no longer follow the input spot position; octagonal or square cores improve near-field scrambling and a double scrambler swaps near and far fields with lenses. Pupil slicing and anamorphic optics split the beam or compress one axis, effectively shrinking the grating required.
units.model: φ = 1″ = 4.85 µrad、D_T = 8.2 m、R4：R = 140 000 需 d_col = R·φ·D_T/(2×4) = 0.70 m，R = 190 000 需 0.94 m；3.6 m 望遠鏡在 R = 115 000 只需 0.25 m。擾頻：導星誤差使光點移動 10% 狹縫寬時，無擾頻位移 0.1×c/R = 214 m/s，擾頻增益 10⁴ 時降為 2.1 cm/s。~With φ = 1″ = 4.85 µrad, D_T = 8.2 m and R4, R = 140 000 needs d_col = R·φ·D_T/(2×4) = 0.70 m and R = 190 000 needs 0.94 m, while a 3.6 m telescope at R = 115 000 needs only 0.25 m. Scrambling: a guiding error moving the spot by 10% of the slit width shifts lines by 0.1×c/R = 214 m/s unscrambled, but only 2.1 cm/s with a scrambling gain of 10⁴.
units.verify: 在實驗室把光點於光纖入口面逐步偏移，以光譜儀量譜線重心變化，或以相機直接拍攝輸出近場與遠場的光重心，擾頻增益等於輸入相對位移除以輸出相對位移；同時量測焦比劣化，確認輸出光錐不超出準直鏡接受角而造成光損與照明變化。~In the lab, step the spot across the fibre entrance and measure the line-centroid change with the spectrograph, or image the output near and far fields directly with a camera; scrambling gain is the relative input displacement divided by the relative output displacement. Also measure focal-ratio degradation to ensure the output cone stays within the collimator acceptance and causes neither light loss nor illumination changes.
units.failure: 圓形芯光纖的近場擾頻不完全，導星偏移與大氣色散沿光纖殘留成 m/s 級速度誤差；光纖受彎曲與應力時產生模態雜訊，在高訊噪比光譜中形成無法平均掉的斑紋，直接限制校正源與亮星的精度。~Circular-core fibres scramble the near field incompletely, so guiding offsets and atmospheric dispersion leak through as m/s-level velocity errors; bending and stress create modal noise, a speckle pattern that does not average out at high SNR and directly limits the precision on calibration sources and bright stars.
units.misconception: 光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。~A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.

units.anchor: 真空容器與溫控屏蔽~Vacuum vessel and thermal shields
units.title: 真空、溫度與壓力穩定的機構設計~Vacuum, temperature and pressure stability
units.mechanism: 光譜儀內任何環境變化都會直接變成譜線位移：空氣折射率 n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ 隨壓力改變而使所有波長整體平移，溫度則改變光柵週期、光學座長度與偵測器位置。因此 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 類儀器把光學平台放進真空容器，外加多層主動溫控屏蔽，以 mK 等級的長期穩定為目標；光學座採用低膨脹材料或同材料對稱結構，偵測器有獨立的低溫恆溫器，電子設備與真空泵等熱源移到容器之外。~Any environmental change inside a spectrograph becomes a line shift: the refractive index of air, n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴, varies with pressure and translates all wavelengths together, while temperature changes grating period, bench length and detector position. HARPS- and ESPRESSO-class instruments therefore put the optical bench inside a vacuum vessel wrapped in nested actively controlled thermal shields aiming at mK-level long-term stability; benches use low-expansion or symmetric same-material structures, the detector has its own cryostat, and heat sources such as electronics and vacuum pumps are moved outside the vessel.
units.model: 空氣 dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷/hPa，每 1 hPa 壓力變化造成 c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s 的假速度；抽到 10⁻⁵ hPa 並保持穩定時降為 0.8 mm/s。Zerodur 光柵 α = 5×10⁻⁸/K、ΔT = 1 mK 給 c·α·ΔT ≈ 1.5 cm/s；但 0.1 m 長的鋁偵測器支架每 mK 伸長 2.3 nm，以 18.7 nm/(m/s) 換算為 0.12 m/s。~Air has dn/dP ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁷ per hPa, so a 1 hPa pressure change fakes c×2.7×10⁻⁷ ≈ 80 m/s, falling to 0.8 mm/s when pumped to a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa. A Zerodur grating with α = 5×10⁻⁸/K and ΔT = 1 mK gives c·α·ΔT ≈ 1.5 cm/s, but a 0.1 m aluminium detector mount grows 2.3 nm per mK, which at 18.7 nm per m/s is 0.12 m/s.
units.verify: 在容器內的光學座、光柵與偵測器頭部布置校正過的鉑電阻溫度計，長期記錄溫度與真空計讀數；同時以同步參考光纖的 ThAr 或標準具譜線量測夜間漂移，把漂移對溫度與壓力做回歸，得出 m/s/mK 與 m/s/hPa 係數並與模型比較。~Fit calibrated platinum resistance thermometers to the bench, grating and detector head inside the vessel and log them with vacuum-gauge readings for weeks; simultaneously measure nightly drift with ThAr or etalon lines through the simultaneous-reference fibre, regress drift against temperature and pressure, and compare the fitted m/s per mK and m/s per hPa coefficients with the model.
units.failure: 偵測器冷卻循環或液氮補充造成的熱脈衝經支架傳到光學座，產生與觀測排程相關的 m/s 級跳動；若真空容器洩漏率逐漸上升，壓力漂移帶來緩慢的速度趨勢，很容易被誤認為長週期行星。~Thermal pulses from detector cooling cycles or liquid-nitrogen refills conduct through mounts to the bench and create m/s-level jumps correlated with the observing schedule; a slowly rising vacuum leak rate produces a pressure drift and a gradual velocity trend that is easily mistaken for a long-period planet.
units.misconception: 只要光柵用零膨脹材料，溫度就不再重要。~If the grating is made of zero-expansion material, temperature no longer matters.

units.anchor: ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳~ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb
units.title: 波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳~Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs
units.mechanism: 波長解把像素位置對應到真空波長，校正源決定能達到的精度。ThAr 空心陰極燈提供數千條絕對波長已知的譜線，但亮度差異大、彼此混疊，氬線隨燈壓位移且燈管會老化；Fabry–Pérot 標準具產生間距均勻、亮度一致的密集譜線，適合描繪像素尺度的色散，但絕對位置隨腔長漂移，需要用 ThAr 或原子譜線錨定。雷射頻率梳的每條梳齒 f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep 由原子鐘參考，間距需經濾波腔放大到 15 至 30 GHz 才能被光譜儀解析，提供最高的準確度與可重現性。~The wavelength solution maps pixel position to vacuum wavelength, and the calibration source sets the attainable precision. ThAr hollow-cathode lamps give thousands of lines with known absolute wavelengths, but their brightness varies widely, lines blend, argon lines shift with lamp pressure and lamps age; Fabry–Pérot etalons give dense, evenly spaced lines of uniform brightness that map dispersion at pixel scale, but their absolute positions drift with cavity length and must be anchored to ThAr or atomic lines. A laser frequency comb, with each tooth at f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep referenced to an atomic clock, needs filter cavities to raise its spacing to 15 to 30 GHz so the spectrograph can resolve it, and delivers the highest accuracy and repeatability.
units.model: 真空間隙 L = 7.5 mm 的標準具 FSR = c/(2L) = 20.0 GHz，在 550 nm 對應 Δλ = λ²·FSR/c = 20.2 pm，約為 R = 140 000 解析元素（3.93 pm）的 5.1 倍，譜線彼此分離。要穩定到 1 m/s，腔長變化須小於 L×(1 m/s)/c = 25 pm。250 MHz 頻率梳經 100 倍濾波得 25 GHz 間距，譜線間隔 25.2 pm。~An etalon with a 7.5 mm vacuum gap has FSR = c/(2L) = 20.0 GHz, or Δλ = λ²·FSR/c = 20.2 pm at 550 nm, about 5.1 times the 3.93 pm resolution element at R = 140 000, so lines are well separated. Holding it to 1 m/s requires the gap to change by less than L×(1 m/s)/c = 25 pm. A 250 MHz comb filtered by a factor of 100 gives 25 GHz spacing, lines every 25.2 pm.
units.verify: 每晚以 ThAr 與標準具或頻率梳各取一組校正影像，對每一級擬合二維多項式或分段色散解，把殘差 rms 換算成速度並與光子雜訊預期比較；比較 ThAr 解與頻率梳解的差值可揭露像素尺寸不均與譜線表誤差，連續多晚追蹤標準具譜線可得其漂移斜率。~Each night take ThAr and etalon or comb calibration frames, fit a two-dimensional polynomial or piecewise dispersion solution per order, convert residual rms to velocity and compare with the photon-noise expectation; differencing the ThAr and comb solutions exposes pixel-size non-uniformity and line-list errors, and tracking etalon lines over several nights yields the etalon drift slope.
units.failure: 頻率梳濾波腔失鎖時，被抑制的鄰近梳齒重新出現，每條譜線變成不對稱的混疊，重心偏移數 m/s 卻仍看似正常譜線；更換 ThAr 燈管後若沒有重新建立參考，氬線壓力位移會讓整個波長解出現跳點。~When a comb's filter cavity loses lock, suppressed neighbouring modes reappear and each line becomes an asymmetric blend whose centroid moves several m/s while still looking normal; replacing a ThAr lamp without re-establishing the reference lets argon pressure shifts introduce a jump into the whole wavelength solution.
units.misconception: ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。~Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source.

units.anchor: 光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表~Photon noise and RV budget table
units.title: 光子雜訊極限與徑向速度誤差預算~Photon-noise limit and radial-velocity error budget
units.mechanism: 在光子雜訊限制下，RV 不確定度 σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e)，N_e 是全部光譜收集到的光電子數，品質因子 Q 描述光譜中譜線的密度與陡度：低溫、慢自轉的 K 矮星 Q 高，高溫、快自轉的 A 型星 Q 很低。實際精度還要加上儀器項：校正源、光纖照明變化、偵測器、熱機構漂移與地球大氣吸收線污染，各項以均方根相加。預算表的目的是讓每個子系統負責人事先知道自己能分到多少誤差，而不是事後找解釋。~In the photon-noise limit the RV uncertainty is σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e), where N_e is the number of photoelectrons collected over the spectrum and the quality factor Q describes line density and steepness: cool, slowly rotating K dwarfs have high Q while hot, fast-rotating A stars have very low Q. Real precision adds instrumental terms, namely calibration source, fibre-illumination changes, detector, thermo-mechanical drift and telluric-line contamination, combined root-sum-square. The budget table tells each subsystem owner in advance how much error they may consume rather than explaining failures afterwards.
units.model: 取 Q = 15 000（教學假設）、N_e = 10⁸：σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s；要達 0.1 m/s 需 N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰。預算範例：光子 0.50、校正 0.10、光纖照明 0.10、偵測器 0.10、熱機構 0.05 m/s，RSS = √(0.25 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0025) = 0.53 m/s。~Taking Q = 15 000 as a teaching assumption and N_e = 10⁸, σ_v = 3×10⁸/(15 000×10⁴) = 2.0 m/s; reaching 0.1 m/s needs N_e = (3×10⁸/1500)² ≈ 4×10¹⁰. Example budget: photon 0.50, calibration 0.10, fibre illumination 0.10, detector 0.10 and thermo-mechanical 0.05 m/s give RSS = √(0.25 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0025) = 0.53 m/s.
units.verify: 對每次曝光由萃取光譜計算光子雜訊 σ_v，與同一晚連續曝光的實際散佈比較，平方差即為未建模的儀器項；對 RV 標準星的長期序列計算 rms 與 Allan 偏差，若在數小時以上的時間尺度不再隨 1/√N 下降，代表儀器漂移或恆星活動等系統誤差主導。~Compute the photon-noise σ_v of every exposure from its extracted spectrum and compare with the actual scatter of consecutive exposures in one night; the quadrature difference is the unmodelled instrumental term. For long RV-standard series compute rms and Allan deviation, and if they stop falling as 1/√N beyond a few hours, systematics such as instrumental drift or stellar activity dominate.
units.failure: 預算只列光子雜訊而忽略月光與天光在光纖中的污染，暗星在接近滿月時出現與月亮相對速度相關的 m/s 偏差；把溫度與焦點這類相關項目當成獨立項做 RSS，會低估總誤差並讓驗收表看似合格。~A budget that lists only photon noise ignores moonlight and sky contamination in the fibre, so faint stars near full Moon show m/s biases tied to the Moon's relative velocity; treating correlated terms such as temperature and focus as independent in the RSS underestimates the total and makes the acceptance table look compliant.
units.misconception: 曝光時間一直加倍，RV 誤差就會無限下降。~Doubling the exposure time keeps reducing RV error without limit.

units.anchor: 大面積 CCD 與萃取管線~Large CCD and extraction pipeline
units.title: 偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取~Detector systematics and spectral extraction
units.mechanism: 二維梯狀影像要經過級追蹤、散射光扣除、最佳萃取與閃耀函數平場校正，才得到每一級的一維光譜，再以交叉相關遮罩或模板比對求 RV。大面積 CCD 帶進三種與速度相關的系統誤差：電荷轉移效率不足使譜線向讀出方向拖尾，且拖尾比例隨通量改變；光罩拼接造成週期性的像素尺寸誤差；像素內量子效率不均。地球公轉使恆星譜線一年內在偵測器上來回移動數十個像素，這些誤差因此被轉成週期一年的假訊號。~The two-dimensional ladder becomes one-dimensional spectra per order only after order tracing, scattered-light subtraction, optimal extraction and blaze flat-field correction, and RV is then derived by cross-correlation masks or template matching. Large CCDs add three velocity-related systematics: charge-transfer inefficiency trails lines toward the readout with a flux-dependent fraction, mask stitching creates periodic pixel-size errors, and quantum efficiency varies within each pixel. Earth's orbit sweeps stellar lines tens of pixels across the detector each year, turning these errors into spurious annual signals.
units.model: CTE = 0.999999、4096 次轉移後殘留比例 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41%，若這部分電荷延後一個像素，重心偏移 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s，低通量時更大。地球軌道速度 ±30 km/s 使譜線移動 ±30 000/535 = ±56 px；10 nm 的拼接邊界誤差相當於 10/18.7 = 0.53 m/s 的跳動。~With CTE = 0.999999, 1 − CTE⁴⁰⁹⁶ = 0.41% of the charge is left behind after 4096 transfers; deferred by one pixel it moves the centroid 0.0041 px × 535 m/s = 2.2 m/s, more at low flux. Earth's orbital ±30 km/s sweeps lines by ±30 000/535 = ±56 px, so a 10 nm stitching-boundary error is a 10/18.7 = 0.53 m/s jump.
units.verify: 用不同強度的平場與標準具影像量測 CTE 與通量相依的重心偏移並建立修正表；改變標準具溫度或使用頻率梳讓譜線掃過偵測器，繪出每個拼接區塊的有效像素位置；以同一顆星不同訊噪比的曝光檢查 RV 是否與訊噪比相關。~Measure CTE and the flux-dependent centroid shift from flat-field and etalon frames at several intensities and build a correction table; tune the etalon temperature or use a comb to sweep lines across the detector and map the effective pixel positions of each stitching block; test whether RV correlates with signal-to-noise ratio using exposures of one star at different signal levels.
units.failure: 管線若未修正拼接誤差，長期資料出現週期一年、振幅約 1 m/s 的訊號，恰與地球公轉同步，容易被誤報為適居帶行星；更換 CCD 控制器時序後 CTE 改變，前後資料出現無法解釋的零點偏移。~An uncorrected stitching error yields a one-year signal of about 1 m/s locked to Earth's orbit, easily misreported as a habitable-zone planet; changing the CCD controller timing alters CTE and leaves an unexplained zero-point offset between data taken before and after.
units.misconception: CCD 像素是完美等距網格，只需校正波長即可。~CCD pixels form a perfect grid, so only wavelength needs calibrating.

units.anchor: 曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星~Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards
units.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接~Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff
units.mechanism: 量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。曝光計在光譜儀內分出一小部分光，記錄通量隨時間的變化以求出加權時間。最後以多顆長期穩定的 RV 標準星、太陽光與校正源夜間漂移紀錄驗收整機，並把光纖組、溫控設定、校正序列與管線版本寫入交接文件。~Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ. An exposure meter picks off a small fraction of the light inside the spectrograph and records flux versus time to obtain that weighted time. Final acceptance uses several long-term RV-stable standards, sunlight and nightly calibration-drift records, and the handoff document fixes the fibre link, thermal set points, calibration sequence and pipeline version.
units.model: 在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。公轉加速度 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s²，同樣 60 s 只造成 0.36 m/s。~At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s. The orbital acceleration 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s² adds only 0.36 m/s for the same 60 s.
units.verify: 驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。~Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change.
units.failure: 更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。~Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter.
units.misconception: 重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。~Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time.

example: 徑向速度預算練習：設計 R = 140 000、λ = 550 nm，每解析元素取樣 4 個 10 µm 像素，每像素 535 m/s，1 m/s = 18.7 nm。8.2 m 望遠鏡、1″ 光纖、R4 光柵需要 d_col = 140 000×4.85×10⁻⁶×8.2/8 = 0.70 m 的準直光束。環境：0.1 m 鋁支架在 1 mK 漂移下貢獻 0.12 m/s，10⁻⁵ hPa 的穩定真空貢獻 0.8 mm/s 可忽略。光子雜訊：Q = 15 000、N_e = 4×10⁹，σ = 3×10⁸/(15 000×6.32×10⁴) = 0.32 m/s。加入校正 0.10、光纖 0.10、偵測器 0.10、熱機構 0.12 m/s，總 RSS = √(0.316² + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0144) = 0.38 m/s。要以 5σ 偵測半振幅 K = 0.09 m/s 的地球類行星，約需 N = 2×(5×0.38/0.09)² ≈ 890 次獨立量測，且尚未計入恆星活動。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Radial-velocity budget exercise: design for R = 140 000 at λ = 550 nm with four 10 µm pixels per resolution element, giving 535 m/s per pixel and 1 m/s = 18.7 nm. An 8.2 m telescope with a 1″ fibre and an R4 grating needs a collimated beam d_col = 140 000×4.85×10⁻⁶×8.2/8 = 0.70 m. Environment: a 0.1 m aluminium mount drifting 1 mK contributes 0.12 m/s, while a stable 10⁻⁵ hPa vacuum contributes a negligible 0.8 mm/s. Photon noise with Q = 15 000 and N_e = 4×10⁹ is σ = 3×10⁸/(15 000×6.32×10⁴) = 0.32 m/s. Adding calibration 0.10, fibre 0.10, detector 0.10 and thermo-mechanical 0.12 m/s gives a total RSS of √(0.316² + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.01 + 0.0144) = 0.38 m/s. Detecting an Earth analogue with semi-amplitude K = 0.09 m/s at 5σ then needs about N = 2×(5×0.38/0.09)² ≈ 890 independent measurements, before stellar activity is considered. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1995 年 Michel Mayor 與 Didier Queloz 以 ELODIE 光纖光譜儀的交叉相關技術發現 51 Pegasi b，精度約 10 m/s 等級；2003 年起 ESO 3.6 m 望遠鏡上的 HARPS 以真空溫控容器與同步 ThAr 參考把長期精度推進到約 1 m/s，2010 年代又在其上測試雷射頻率梳。2017 年 ESPRESSO 在 VLT 組合庫德實驗室取得初光，可接收單一或四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的光，以 10 cm/s 為長期目標。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~In 1995 Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz discovered 51 Pegasi b using cross-correlation with the fibre-fed ELODIE spectrograph at roughly 10 m/s precision; from 2003 HARPS on the ESO 3.6 m telescope pushed long-term precision to about 1 m/s with a vacuum, temperature-controlled vessel and simultaneous ThAr reference, and laser frequency combs were tested on it during the 2010s. In 2017 ESPRESSO saw first light in the VLT combined coudé laboratory, accepting light from one or all four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes with a long-term goal of 10 cm/s. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
